title: Great UI, but leaves a lot to be desired.
body:
Loading speed - takes a few seconds to complete one habit after holding it down. Loading times could definitely be quicker. I wanna log my habits fast and move on with my day. The “congratulations” habit completion screen was nice at first, but i dont need to see the animation for the 20th time that I log a habit, cos it takes too long  to load. maybe it’s better for it to be shown for certain milestones (1st week, 2 weeks in a row, 1 month in a row, 2 months in a row, etc)

Logging previous day - As humans, we sometimes tend to forget. And this applies for forgetting to log a habit for previous day. The option to log it needs to be more obvious, and be accessed quicker.

App Widget form - there needs to be a better way to present your habit info in the widget, because right now they just appear super tiny especially if you’re trying to log more than 6+ habits.
author: eetzra

title: One of the best habit tracking apps
body: Definitely one of the best habit tracking apps I’ve tried. I love the design, the habit template and review is helpful, the mindset articles help as well. The only problem is the price and that you can only track 3 habits at once (though I think that’s on purpose by Clear)
author: Haikal Kushahrin

title: It’s a great app
body: It’s a great app, aesthetically enough and easy to use. However, would hope that it would be a free-for-all option in order to make anyone have access and cultivating new/better habits
author: Tzeyangg
